observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The word 'Nikon' is visible on the top of the camera body. The lens has 'DX' and '24-70mm' markings. The camera body shows some dust and wear. A lens cap is placed in front of the lens.
Photo 1: Side view of the same camera, showing the mode dial, shutter button, and the lens. The lens barrel has 'DX' and '24-70mm' visible. The camera body has a red accent on the grip.

Photo 2: Front view with the lens cap removed, showing the front of the lens. The lens barrel has 'DX' and '24-70mm' markings. The camera body has 'Nikon' visible. The lens cap is placed separately in front of the lens.
All photos show the camera and lens on a floral-patterned fabric surface. The camera appears to be a Nikon D3200 based on the seller's text and visible branding.

claims.claim: While the D3200 is a pro-level camera, it's certainly more than accessible by those who are not...
claims.evidence: The seller's text is subjective and not verifiable from the photos. The camera appears to be a Nikon D3200 based on branding, but no model number is visible in any photo.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have a faulty sensor or lens.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a photo, or a photo of the camera's LCD screen displaying a live image.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light.

risks.risk: The camera may have a damaged shutter or other mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera's shutter count or a test shot taken with the camera.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera's LCD screen showing a live image or menu.
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light.
Photo of the camera's serial number or model label if visible.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
